info.title: Hymnal API
info.description: A FastAPI-based API for managing hymn books and hymns, with admin user management and search functionality.

post.description:
Register a new user in the system.
- **user**: User creation details (username, email, password, etc.).
- Requires authentication and `create_user` permission.
- Superusers can set `is_super_user=true`; others cannot.

Authenticate a user and issue a JWT token.
- **form_data**: Username and password.
- Returns a bearer token valid for 30 minutes.
- If 2FA is enabled, verification may be required (currently optional).

Set up two-factor authentication for the authenticated user.
- Returns a TOTP secret to be used with an authenticator app.
- Requires authentication and `setup_2fa` permission.

schema.title: Response Setup 2Fa Endpoint Api V1 User Management 2Fa Setup Post

post.description:
Verify a TOTP token for the authenticated user.
- **token**: The 6-digit TOTP code from an authenticator app.
- Requires authentication and `verify_2fa` permission.

put.description:
Update an existing user's details.
- **user_id**: The ID of the user to update.
- **user_update**: Updated user details (e.g., email, first_name, is_super_user).
- Only superusers can change `is_super_user`.
- Requires authentication and `update_user` permission.

delete.description:
Soft delete a user by setting is_active to false.
- **user_id**: The ID of the user to delete.
- Superusers are protected from deletion.
- Requires authentication and `delete_user` permission.

post.description:
Upload a profile image for a user.
- **user_id**: The ID of the user.
- **image**: The image file (must be JPEG or PNG).
- Requires authentication and `update_user` permission.

Create a new role for the RBAC system.
- **name**: Unique name of the role (e.g., 'editor').
- **description**: Optional description of the role.
- Requires authentication and `create_role` permission.

schema.title: Response Create Role Api Api V1 User Management Roles Post

post.description:
Create a new permission for the RBAC system.
- **name**: Unique name of the permission (e.g., 'edit_hymn').
- **description**: Optional description of the permission.
- Requires authentication and `create_permission` permission.

schema.title: Response Create Permission Api Api V1 User Management Permissions Post

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description:
Assign a role to a user.
- **user_id**: The ID of the user.
- **role_id**: The ID of the role to assign.
- Requires authentication and `assign_role` permission.

post.summary: Assign a permission to a role
post.description:
Assign a permission to a role for RBAC.
- **role_id**: The ID of the role.
- **permission_id**: The ID of the permission to assign.
- Requires authentication and `assign_permission` permission.

Create a new hymn book.
- **hymn_book**: Hymn book details (title).
- Requires authentication and `create_hymn_book` permission.

get.description:
Retrieve a list of all available hymn books.
- Public endpoint (no authentication required).

schema.title: Response Read All Hymn Books Api V1 Hymnal Hymn Books Get

get.summary: Get a hymn book by ID
get.description:
Retrieve a single hymn book and its details.
- **hymn_book_id**: The unique ID of the hymn book.
- Public endpoint (no authentication required).

delete.description:
Delete a hymn book and its thumbnail file.
- **hymn_book_id**: The ID of the hymn book.
- Requires authentication and `delete_hymn_book` permission.

post.description:
Upload a thumbnail image for a hymn book.
- **hymn_book_id**: The ID of the hymn book.
- **thumbnail**: The image file (JPEG or PNG).
- Requires authentication and `update_hymn_book` permission.

Create a new hymn in a hymn book.
- **hymn**: Hymn details (title, number, content with verses as list of {verse_tag, verse_name, verse_content}, optional chorus, optional variant_key).
- Requires authentication and `create_hymn` permission.
- Validates content: at least one verse; chorus optional.

get.description:
Retrieve a specific hymn.
- **hymn_id**: The ID of the hymn.
- Public endpoint (no authentication required).

put.description:
Update an existing hymn.
- **hymn_id**: The ID of the hymn.
- **hymn**: Updated hymn details (verses as list of {verse_tag, verse_name, verse_content}, optional chorus, optional variant_key).
- Requires authentication and `update_hymn` permission.
- Validates content: at least one verse; chorus optional.

delete.description:
Delete a hymn from a hymn book.
- **hymn_id**: The ID of the hymn.
- Requires authentication and `delete_hymn` permission.

get.summary: Get hymns by hymn book ID
get.description: Retrieve all hymns belonging to a specific hymn book.

200.description: List of hymns in the hymn book

schema.title: Response Get Hymns By Hymn Book Api V1 Hymnal Hymn Books  Hymn Book Id  Hymns Get

get.description: Search hymns using optional filters: title (partial match), number, hymn_book_id.

schema.title: Response Search Hymns Filtered Api V1 Hymnal Search Get

get.description:
Get all variants/versions of a hymn from other books.
- **hymn_id**: The ID of the base hymn.
- Matches by `variant_key` or title similarity.
- Public endpoint.

schema.title: Response Get Hymn Variants Endpoint Api V1 Hymnal Hymns  Hymn Id  Variants Get
